attempts.text:
**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `cspH`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 77% of calls. The model names 99% of them, at 0.30 bits.

**The rest of the window is fork and variable columns**, 1 to 79, carried by 58 to 90%, 65 persistent and 14 shell. A branch of 3 families runs through columns 2 to 4, `ymcF` to `gnsA`, in 10%. The `hya` genes, columns 12 to 17, are [[hydrogenase formation]].

**The model names more genes on the spine column than on the fork and variable ones**, 99 against 94%, and hesitates more there, 0.30 against 0.26 bits. Its most hesitant column, 48, `elfC`, is a variable column, at 0.71 bits.

**The window ends on fork columns.** Columns 72 to 79, `ycaQ` to `ycaL`, are carried by 76 to 84%, all persistent. The last column is `ycaL`, in 76% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 94% of genes**, 0.26 bits on average, perplexity 1.4 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.89 against 0.12 bits, and names fewer genes, 80% against 97%.

label: cspH
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the cspH window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor cspH, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,702 to 2,781 from dnaA. Read in 527 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying cspH once); 42,160 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 94% of genes, 0.26 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 34,717 calls, named 98%, 0.12 bits; shell 7,140 calls, named 80%, 0.81 bits; cloud 303 calls, named 12%, 3.66 bits. Outside an RGP 34,512 calls, named 97%, 0.12 bits; inside an RGP 7,648 calls, named 80%, 0.89 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 12 fork, 67 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.89 against 0.12 bits) and names fewer genes (80% against 97%); 7,648 of the 42,160 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 48 (elfC, a variable column) 0.71 bits, RGP 64%; column 46 (ycbU, a variable column) 0.57 bits, RGP 67%; column 47 (elfG, a variable column) 0.55 bits, RGP 65%. The 14 columns (columns 0-7 and 44-49) where most calls are in an RGP: named 93%, 0.42 bits on average; the other 66 columns: named 94%, 0.23 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 99%, 0.30 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 94%, 0.26 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates more there. Its most hesitant column, 48, is a variable column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 77%. Genes: cspH. named 99%; 0.30 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 58-90%, 65 P, 14 S, RGP 1-77%. named 74-99% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 65, named 74%; most hesitant at column 48, 0.71 bits.
[S2.b2]    a second branch of 3 families through columns 2-4, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10%, all P; the branch's families: ymcF, ymcE, gnsA
[S2.b72]    a second branch of 4 families through columns 72-75, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-18%, all P; the branch's families: pflA, ycaD, ycaC, dmsC
[S2.b76]    a second branch of 3 families through columns 76-78, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 23-26%, all P; the branch's families: ycaO, focA, pflB
